title: Principal Constituents of the Thermosphere
description: The gases in the lower layers of Earth's atmosphere (the troposphere, stratosphere, and mesosphere) are well-mixed, and the density of each different type of gas (nitrogen, oxygen, etc.) declines at about the same rate with increasing altitude. However, in the extremely thin air of the thermosphere the mixture of gases no longer behaves as much like a well-mixed fluid as it does in the denser, lower atmosphere. The physics of particle (molecules and atoms of gases) motion begins to play an increasingly important role in governing the behavior of the constituents of the thermosphere. description: Be rest assured this is not a clash of titans; it's a fine combination of mathematics and physics. At the start of each level, you will be given a lever which has labels to indicate the distances between the marked positions and the pivot of the lever. The objects and their weights are displayed at the bottom of the screen. As you advance in the game, the number of objects will increase, and the calculation will become more complicated. title: Hymns of the Drowning Swimmer
description: On a trip to Ballarat, driving through the rural areas surrounding the town, I came across an crumbling church that now housed a make-shift antique store. At the bottom of a dusty book stack was a hymnal, with an inscription to a woman whose son had recently drowned. I was taken with the way water had become the music of the land in this area, how it defined so much of their lives and deaths. This digital poem creates a series of interactive poetic hymns, in part to this drowned son, and in part to the region and its own “drowning in drought”. An anthology of poems. I'm a strange lefty, so there is an option to change the control configuration. If you can't find it, you have bigger issues than solving a puzzle game. Sokoban is a puzzle game where you must push boxes onto set squares. You can only push one box at a time, and you cannot pull, so be careful not to get then trapped! There are 52 levels, and a reset button so try the levels all you want. See if you can beat all 52! The first 20 are sorted by difficulty; after that, you can deal with fluctuations in difficulty.

The retro concept is better suited to this format and can now be played instantly to kill a few minutes wherever you happen to be. Firing from each side of the battlefield, you have to catch enemies in your cross-fire without hitting each other (which is more difficult than it sounds). Simply hit the Left or Right cursors to fire from either side. Use Up and Down to tug at the rope bomb, before hitting Space to detonate it for multiple kills! If you prefer, you can also click on various game elements as though it were a touch-screen mobile app...

description: A text-based “Choose Your Own Adventure”-style interactive fiction game loosely based on a novel I’ve been writing and rewriting for about 17 years. So if you ever find yourself thinking, “Wow, this reads like it was written by a 13-year-old,” well, you’re not far off! It’s set in the same universe as Thousand Dollar Soul; you don’t need to read that one first, but if you did, you’ll probably notice a few small crossover elements. Those who are easily offended should be warned that God’s Assassin pokes fun at religious concepts pretty mercilessly. If you’re curious as to what my real beliefs are, you can learn more than you ever cared to know at we-are-1.net.

title: 3D Horse Box
description: This example of 3D uses animated movieclips to make up the sides of the box shown. title: 3D Spinning Earth
description: Here the enhanced drawing API of Flash Player 10 is used to create a 3D spinning globe (earth). All of the 3D coordinates are generated dynamically at run time with a mapped graphic defined using UVT. The Matrix3D class is used to apply a rotation and Utils3D.projectVectors is used to convert 3D points into the 2D points that get drawn to the screen (as well as define T for bitmap distortion). Combine that with some objects in an IGraphicsData using culling to manage the 2 different sides of the globe and you get this. Press and hold the left mouse button and you will be able to see the geometry.

title: Drag And Drop Behaviors
description: This example shows how you can immitate Director-like behaviors in Flash MX using components. Just drag a component movieclip onto another movieclip to have its actions copied to that movieclip to add to its functionality during playback. The rotating planet here has 3 behaviors added to it. One makes it spin, one fades and a third scales the clip when you click your mouse button. A custom method called ASEventBroadcaster is used to assure that multiple behaviors can still function even if they attempt to use the same event (like the onEnterFrame event) for the same movieclip.

tags: Toy; Educational; Music; Soundboard; Auditory Illusion; Optical Illusion
description: Follow these twelve steps as they go around in either direction. They seem go on forever and never get anywhere, no matter which way you go; up or down. Mouse over any step to hear a musical chord. Follow the music around in either direction.
